content: mds1: Focused on protocol maintenance and technical debt reduction, specifically leading the deprecation and removal of legacy SystemConfig getters across the Optimism ecosystem as seen in PRs #21641, #1798, and #1491. They demonstrated significant cross-functional impact by ensuring downstream compatibility in the superchain-registry and op-analytics repositories, while also strengthening post-fork security through new L2 predeploy verification (#21697). Beyond their 20 commits, they were a prolific contributor to the codebase's quality, providing 23 thorough peer reviews. Their primary focus this month centered on smart contract refactoring, configuration updates, and enhancing the robustness of the testing suite.
